mapper.sql: SELECT s.*, d.doc_no AS trade_doc_no, o.order_no, c.name AS customer_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, sp.code AS carrier_supplier_code, sp.name AS carrier_supplier_name FROM scm_shipment s LEFT JOIN scm_supplier sp ON sp.id = s.carrier_supplier_id JOIN scm_trade_doc d ON d.id = s.trade_doc_id JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = d.order_id JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = s.create_by
